mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE ctrt_type_cd IN ('MO','DP') AND proj_stat_cd NOT IN ('PRE','LOSE') ORDER BY proj_nm,proj_id
SELECT a.asgn_id AS "id",d.dev_nm AS "developerName",d.mng_no AS "managementNo" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.proj_id=#{id} ORDER BY a.asgn_id

SELECT b.bill_id AS "id",b.bill_dt AS "billingDate",b.sply_amt AS "supplyAmount",b.vat_rt AS "vatRate", COALESCE(r.amount,0) AS "receiptAmount" FROM tb_bl_bill b LEFT JOIN (SELECT bill_id,sum(rcpt_amt) AS amount FROM tb_bl_rcpt WHERE cncl_yn='N' GROUP BY bill_id) r ON r.bill_id=b.bill_id WHERE b.proj_id=#{projectId} AND b.bill_ym=#{month} AND b.cncl_yn='N' ORDER BY b.bill_dt DESC,b.bill_id DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'project',(SELECT to_jsonb(p)-'proj_nm' FROM tb_pj_proj p WHERE p.proj_id=#{projectId}), 'assignments',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.asgn_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE a.proj_id=#{projectId}), 'months',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.asgn_id,m.input_ym),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon m WHERE m.proj_id=#{projectId}), 'histories',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(h) ORDER BY h.asgn_id,h.hist_sn),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist h JOIN tb_pj_asgn a ON a.asgn_id=h.asgn_id WHERE a.proj_id=#{projectId}), 'bills',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) ORDER BY b.bill_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_bl_bill b WHERE b.proj_id=#{projectId} AND b.bill_ym=#{month}), 'receipts',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.rcpt_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_bl_rcpt r JOIN tb_bl_bill b ON b.bill_id=r.bill_id WHERE b.proj_id=#{projectId} AND b.bill_ym=#{month}) )::text

SELECT jsonb_build_object('bill',to_jsonb(b),'receipts',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.rcpt_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_bl_rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id))::text FROM tb_bl_bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT b.bill_id AS "billId",b.proj_id AS "projectId",p.proj_nm AS "projectName", b.tot_amt-COALESCE(r.amount,0) AS "unpaidAmount",b.pay_due_dt AS "dueDate" FROM tb_bl_bill b JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=b.proj_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT bill_id,sum(rcpt_amt) AS amount FROM tb_bl_rcpt WHERE cncl_yn='N' GROUP BY bill_id) r ON r.bill_id=b.bill_id WHERE b.cncl_yn='N' AND b.tot_amt-COALESCE(r.amount,0)>0 AND b.pay_due_dt < #{today} ORDER BY (#{today}::date-b.pay_due_dt) DESC,b.pay_due_dt,b.bill_id

SELECT bill_id AS "billId",dun_sn::int AS "sn",dun_step::int AS "step",send_dt AS "sendDate", rcvr_desc AS "receiverDescription",send_mthd_cd AS "sendMethodCode",resend_yn='Y' AS "resend" FROM tb_bl_dun_hist WHERE bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY send_dt,dun_sn

SELECT u.user_id AS "userId",u.user_nm AS "name",r.role_id AS "role" FROM tb_sy_user u JOIN tb_sy_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND r.use_yn='Y' AND r.role_id IN ('PM','SALES_LDR','EXEC','FIN') ORDER BY u.user_id,r.role_id

SELECT s.user_id AS "userId",s.scope_type_cd AS "type",s.part_id AS "partId",s.proj_id AS "projectId" FROM tb_sy_user_scope s JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' ORDER BY s.user_id,s.scope_sn

SELECT pp.part_id AS "partId",COALESCE(p.hq_yn='Y',false) AS "headquarters",s.part_ldr_user_id AS "leaderId" FROM tb_pj_proj_part pp LEFT JOIN tb_bs_part p ON p.part_id=pp.part_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT part_ldr_user_id FROM tb_bs_part_std WHERE part_id=pp.part_id AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE pp.proj_id=#{id} AND pp.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY pp.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
